items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Bob Frank, his brother was Al C.

ctx.x: Do you remember any bands right there? No, no, no, no, no, no. I knew they had all that. Do you recognize the name Bob Frank? Bob?
Bob Frank, he played with a piccolo. Remember him? Bob Frank, his brother was Al C.
Remember piccolo player, he played like that. I don't know how piccolo player played.
